svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.21k stars in total, about 1.76k a year earlier. jactionlint 312, mr boxington 691, aube 2059, fnox 2359, hk 1300, pitchfork 709, usage 1071, +6 more 704.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
